verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation configurations is a fair question for a document-processing platform, so the axis applies, but the pack shows no such capability. Saved classification configurations referenced by ID (docs-39) are reusable but not shown to be versioned. The `version="latest"` parameter (docs-11) selects the parser engine version, not a version of the user's own automations. Nothing in the pack documents review or rollback.
